planImpact.nextP4Action: The AC1012/AC1014 DICTIONARY/GROUP common-link profile now passes bounded role/count controls and the source-bound R13 recheck. ODA 27.1 GUI audit emitted the ordered GROUP members and dictionary/parent relations but dropped TREAT_AS_HARD EED and the referenced SHAPE. libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.method: Temporary local adapter-test instrumentation imported the witness through dx_iface, compared the GROUP, NOD, dictionary and model-space entity identities, then inspected the retained standard-object evidence. Instrumentation was removed; no fixture or test dependency was added.
libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.specCrossCheck: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.72 specifies the R13–R14 GROUP object size and reactor count followed by the common parent/reactor/extension-dictionary references and the ordered group-member references. §§20.4.1–20.4.2 define the corresponding legacy entity common fields and handle roles. This supports inspecting the bounded in-frame parse; it does not by itself validate libdxfrw’s Unknown capture marker or resolve the dictionary text issue.
libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.disposition: Historical pre-classifier recheck. At that point the selected projection admission gate rejected DICTIONARY and GROUP because common-link evidence was Unknown; the DICTIONARY also carried UnknownCodePage text issue mask 0x8. See legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck for the current common-link result. The EED text gate and whole-source refusal remain.

odaGuiConversion.method: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 native macOS GUI Audit on a scratch copy, saved as 2010 ASCII DXF; no CLI retry and no repository fixture added.
odaGuiConversion.interpretation: This independent conversion supports only that ODA emitted the candidate GROUP's ordered member references and dictionary/parent relations for this source. It dropped the source DICTIONARY EED value TREAT_AS_HARD and the referenced SHAPE object, so it is not lossless and does not define EED codepage-zero semantics. By itself this output does not validate libdxfrw's source spans or handle roles; those are separately qualified in legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck. The EED gate remains.

eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.method: A temporary diagnostic in readDwgEed logged the APPID handle, byte count and raw bytes for legacy EED strings whose per-value codepage was zero. The instrumentation was removed; no source or test change remains.

dictionaryEed.independentReader: LibreDWG 0.14 JSON identifies APPID handle 0x12 as ACAD and decodes the same EED value as TREAT_AS_HARD; this corroborates the ASCII value, not the semantics of per-value codepage zero.

eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.authorityReview: ODA v5.4.1 chapter 28 specifies the legacy EED string length, 2-byte codepage and character bytes, but does not define codepage 0 as inheriting the file codepage. LibreDWG's file-header codepage-0 fallback is not evidence for EED per-value semantics.
eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.disposition: The exact value producing the DICTIONARY UnknownCodePage issue is now bound. The common-link gate is separately resolved by legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck. Keep the text gate closed. Do not map per-value codepage 0 to the file codepage without normative or independent producer evidence defining that rule.

legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck.method: Current libdxfrw build imported the source read-only via dwg2dxf -d. The classifier log was captured after the typed DICTIONARY/GROUP parse and before any strict output setup. No fixture or repository copy was added.

legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck.specCrossCheck: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.4.1–20.4.2, §20.4.44 and §20.4.72 define the bounded R13/R14 common links, dictionary item handles, and group members. This profile is scoped only to AC1012/AC1014 DICTIONARY/GROUP typed parsers; other legacy objects remain Unknown.
legacyCommonLinkProfileRecheck.remainingGate: DICTIONARY EED APPID ACAD value TREAT_AS_HARD carries per-value codepage 0; ODA v5.4.1 does not define zero as inheriting the file codepage. Keep the UnknownCodePage issue and selected-output refusal.
